purpose: Combined-product pricing arithmetic; workload/critical-path normalization remains open

primaryWording.planWording:
The Developer plan is perfect for solo developers, side-projects, and experiments. It includes 500 Docker build minutes, 2,000 GitHub Actions minutes, 2,000 Depot CI minutes, and 1 user, with additional usage billed monthly.
The Startup plan is great for teams building production applications. It includes 5,000 Docker build minutes, 20,000 GitHub Actions minutes, 20,000 Depot CI minutes, and unlimited users, with additional usage billed monthly.
The Business plan is for dev teams looking to scale, and includes additional security controls and deployment models.
primaryWording.storageWording:
You are charged monthly for build usage and storage. See usage granularity above for how build time is measured.

Storage is a single combined total that covers your container build cache, Depot Cache, and Depot Registry. All three draw from your plan's included storage, and anything above that amount is billed at $0.20 per GB per month. Storage is billed as the average storage used over the month, sampled hourly.

Data transfer into and out of Depot Registry is free on the default Standard CDN speed. If you switch your organization to Fast CDN speed, data served out of the registry is billed at $0.10 per GB, from the first GB. Read more in our registry documentation.
primaryWording.testsWording:
The Developer and Startup plans each include 1,000,000 passing test results per month at no charge. After that, it's $0.000001 per passing test, or $1 per 1 million tests. Failed, errored, and skipped tests are free.

Read more in our test results documentation
